basic_info.description: Sweeping views to the Pacific define this beautifully updated Midtown Terrace home. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 remodeled baths all on the one upper level.  There is a  modern eat-in  kitchen with new countertops and appliances  highlighted as well with the western facing window showcasing the ocean view. The  main level  is finished with hardwood floors throughout and a cozy wood-burning fireplace in the living room.     A versatile bonus room on the lower level is ideal as a fourth bedroom, home office, or gym. The two-car side-by-side garage provides abundant parking plus development potential for future expansion.    The landscaped rear yard offers low-maintenance greenery, afternoon sun, and stunning sunset viewsperfect for relaxing or entertaining.    Midtown Terrace is one of San Francisco's most centrally located neighborhoods, offering easy access to public transportation and city conveniences. Residents enjoy close proximity to the Forest Hill and West Portal Muni stations with underground lines that run directly downtown, as well as the 36, 43, 44, and 52 bus routes that connect to neighborhoods across the city. Tech shuttle stops nearby also make commuting to the Peninsula simple. Within minutes, you can reach West Portal Village or Forest hill Station.
